rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via name and ZIP lookup and viewed the user’s orders. They also appropriately escalated to a human because the user requested a refund to an AMEX card while only PayPal was on file, which the agent could not handle. However, the user also urgently requested the tracking number and to return all items except the pet bed. There is no evidence the agent provided the tracking number, confirmed the specific items to be returned, or initiated any return flow with confirmation prior to a write (no return action/tool call). While handoff for the payment method issue aligns with policy, the agent did not complete the actionable parts they could handle (e.g., providing tracking info) nor confirm/order any changes. Thus it does not meet the pass bar of completing the user’s request and providing correct final information.
